themes.title: Adding a new payee is manual and pushes users to competitors
themes.summary: Requiring account + routing numbers to add a payee (instead of phone/email lookup) is slow enough that the participant switched to a competing P2P app to complete the task.
supporting_quotes: My friend had to go find a blank check to read it off to me over text.
I actually gave up and used a different app... It was way faster.

themes.title: Security holds and limits are invisible until they block you
themes.summary: Both the 24-hour new-payee hold and transfer limits are undocumented in-app; the participant only discovered them by hitting an error or calling support.
supporting_quotes: the app doesn't explain why or tell you when the hold will lift
I hit the limit and had no idea what the limit even was beforehand

pain_points.description: Adding a new payee requires manually entering account and routing numbers instead of a phone number or email lookup.
pain_points.quote: I actually gave up and used a different app, one of those peer-to-peer ones, because it just needed their phone number.

pain_points.description: The mandatory 24-hour hold on new payees is not explained in-app, causing users to think the app is broken and contact support.
pain_points.quote: I called support, waited on hold for like fifteen minutes.

pain_points.description: Transfer limits are not shown to the user before they attempt a transfer, only surfaced as a hard block after the fact.
pain_points.quote: I hit the limit and had no idea what the limit even was beforehand.

action_items.action: Support phone-number or email-based payee lookup for transfers.
action_items.rationale: User abandoned the primary flow entirely and switched to a competitor over this.

action_items.action: Add an in-app banner explaining the 24-hour new-payee security hold at the moment it's applied.
action_items.rationale: Prevents unnecessary support calls; user assumed the app was broken.

action_items.action: Surface transfer limits proactively in the transfer flow before the user hits them.
action_items.rationale: Improves transparency for larger/less routine transfers.
